prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1015; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute low back pain and stiffness. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, findings that fit well with the mechanism and force of the impact. Imaging was obtained and clearly confirmed the soft tissue injury consistent with a lumbar strain. The patient reported no prior injury to this body region, and no earlier treatment for the area is known to this office.

Care was conservative and followed a typical course, including hands-on therapy, a home stretching program, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. The patient attended four visits, with the frequency of visits and treatment intensity tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Billing records reflect a single charge for each visit, with no repeated or duplicate services. At the most recent visit the patient reported minimal residual discomfort and was discharged to self-directed home exercise, with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
